title: Classic German Chicken Schnitzel
description: A traditional German dish made with breaded and fried chicken, typically served with a side of fries or a salad.
instructions: Prepare the breading station by placing the flour and breadcrumbs in separate dishes.
Pound the chicken breasts to 1/4 inch thickness.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Dip the chicken in the flour, then the egg, and finally the breadcrumbs, pressing the crumbs onto the chicken to ensure they stick.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the breaded chicken to the skillet and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and let it rest for a few minutes.
Serve the schnitzel hot with your favorite sides.
